guide.summary: Harvest v3 partner integration for customers (partner acceptance); AI agent through Greenhouse MCP server (app review).
guide.verdict: Easiest: AI agent through Greenhouse MCP server (app review). Hardest: Harvest v3 partner integration for customers (partner acceptance).

composio.note: Composio lists Greenhouse as managed OAuth, so prototypes need no own app. Check the toolkit page for each method.

need_own_app.answer: Not for prototypes: Composio's managed app works. For production under your own brand, quota or scopes, you need your own Greenhouse partner credentials, which require partner acceptance and a signed agreement.
reasons: Consent screen shows 'Composio wants to access your account' with the managed app
Managed apps share quota across all Composio users
Managed default scopes may not cover what you need
Managed auth enforces a 15-minute minimum trigger polling interval

scenarios.label: Harvest v3 partner integration for customers
scenarios.when_this_applies: You want your own branded OAuth app for Greenhouse customers using the Harvest v3 partner API.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: Reviews run monthly and Greenhouse contacts applicants within 7 business days after; agreement and credential turnaround not documented.

scenarios.approval: Partner application review, signed partnership agreement, credentials from Partner Support, then review before launch in the Partner Directory.
extras: At least one mutual customer needed to apply
Active website with Privacy Policy needed to apply
Partner decides if Site Admin or standard user

modifiers.note: At least one mutual customer needed to apply
Active website with Privacy Policy needed to apply
Partner decides if Site Admin or standard user sets up

scenarios.label: AI agent through Greenhouse MCP server
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent connects to the Greenhouse MCP server using OAuth with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: Redirect-URI allowlisting is manual; no turnaround documented.

scenarios.approval: Custom clients need Greenhouse to manually allowlist their redirect URI; the global supported-tools list is vetted against two requirements.
extras: Site Admin enables data categories in MCP Access

modifiers.note: Site Admin enables data categories in MCP Access

prerequisites.title: At least one mutual customer
prerequisites.detail: The integration request cannot be submitted without one.

prerequisites.title: Active website with Privacy Policy
prerequisites.detail: Required to apply to the partner program.

prerequisites.title: 128x128 logo
prerequisites.detail: Customers see it when authorizing your integration.

prerequisites.title: Greenhouse Site Admin on the customer side
prerequisites.detail: A Site Admin enables MCP data categories and scopes.

steps.title: Check Composio managed app for prototype
steps.detail: Use the Composio-managed Greenhouse toolkit to prototype while the partner process runs.
steps.done_when: A test connection works through the managed app.

steps.title: Submit integration request form
steps.detail: Describe your integration and goals; include a mutual customer and your website with Privacy Policy.

steps.title: Wait for monthly review
steps.detail: Requests are reviewed on the first Monday of each month; Greenhouse contacts you within 7 business days. Acceptance is not guaranteed.
steps.done_when: Greenhouse invites you to sign the agreement.

steps.title: Sign Partnership Agreement
steps.detail: Legal signature is needed before OAuth setup begins.

steps.title: Draft credential request details
steps.detail: Prepare integration name, environment, minimal scopes, redirect URI and a 128x128 logo. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard for the auth config.
inputs: Scope list from Harvest API docs

steps.title: Email Partner Support for credentials
steps.detail: Send the details to Greenhouse Partner Support and report the final redirect URI once tested.
steps.done_when: You receive Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API with your own client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test user can connect.

steps.title: Submit for review and launch
steps.detail: Submit the integration for review to launch in the Partner Directory.

steps.title: Request redirect URI allowlisting
steps.detail: Contact Greenhouse to add your custom client's redirect URI to the allowlist, using a distinct client_id.

traps.title: Setup cannot start before acceptance
traps.detail: You cannot create the OAuth app until the partnership agreement is signed, and submitting the form does not confirm approval.

traps.title: Scope changes go through email
traps.detail: You cannot change scopes yourself; adding scopes requires users to re-authorize. Choose scopes carefully upfront.

traps.title: Redirect URI must match exactly
traps.detail: A redirect URI not registered for the client ID returns an invalid_request error.

traps.title: Requests missing the monthly cycle wait a month
traps.detail: Out-of-cycle review is generally only for urgent requests from a mutual customer.

traps.title: MCP scope changes log everyone out
traps.detail: Changing scopes in MCP Access invalidates all active MCP tokens in the organization.

traps.title: Authorizing user may lack permissions
traps.detail: A user who authorizes may lack in-app permissions, causing 403 errors.

blockers.symptom: Application not accepted or no response
blockers.what_it_means: Not all submissions are accepted and you must wait for official confirmation.
blockers.what_to_do: Wait for the next monthly cycle; email partneronboarding@greenhouse.io only for urgent mutual-customer needs.

blockers.what_it_means: You requested scopes not permitted for your client.
blockers.what_to_do: Email Partner Support to add the scope, then have users re-authorize.
blockers.agent_can_help: Compare requested scopes to those registered.

open_questions: How long do partnership agreement signing and credential issuance take after acceptance? Ask partneronboarding@greenhouse.io.
What does the pre-launch Partner Directory review check, and how long does it take? Ask Partner Support.
Are there user or install caps on production? Not stated; ask Partner Support.
Does the MCP route allow third-party commercial agents beyond the supported list? Ask Greenhouse via the MCP security FAQ contact.
Does Composio's managed Greenhouse app use the Harvest v3 partner API or another scheme? Check the Composio toolkit page.
